title.zh: 间隔与植树 · 段数和点数差一
title.en: Intervals & Fences · Gaps and Posts Differ by One

desc.zh: 路边种树、锯木头、爬楼梯：数“点”和数“段”总是差一个，看清两头种不种就不会数错。
desc.en: Planting trees, sawing logs, climbing stairs: counting “points” and counting “gaps” differ by one, and checking the ends tells you which way.

legacyLayout._note: Whitespace and markup of the hand-written lesson this page was converted from, so the conversion could be checked byte for byte (specs/site-template.md §3c).
